天.o: Depicts a person (大) with an emphasized head. Based on the original meaning "head". The meaning later shifted to "top", "high", and "sky".
x: 我的天啊！
Wǒ de tiān a!
Oh my God!
你今天好像不太高兴。
Nǐ jīntiān hǎoxiàng bù tài gāoxìng.
You don't look very happy today.
你明天有安排吗？
Nǐ míngtiān yǒu ānpái ma?
Are you doing anything tomorrow?

c.h: 讠 is a component form of 言.

让.o: Phonosemantic compound. 讠 represents the meaning and 上 represents the sound. Simplified form of 讓.
w: to transfer (one's property or rights to sb else)
to concede; to give in; to yield
to get out of the way; to step aside
x: 妈妈不让我去。
Māma bù ràng wǒ qù.
Mum won't let me go.
他丝毫不肯让步。
Tā sīháo bùkěn ràngbù.
He won't make the slightest concession.
让我们联合一起把这项工作做好。
Ràng wǒmen liánhé yīqǐ bǎ zhè xiàng gōngzuò zuò hǎo.
Let's team up to get this task finished.
co: to force the other party to give in

兩.o: Combination of two 丙 characters. 丙 also represents the sound.

孩.o: Phonosemantic compound. 子 represents the meaning and 亥 represents the sound.
x: 不要哭得像个孩子似的。
Bù yào kū dé xiàng ge háizi shìde.
Don't cry like a child!
他对那位漂亮的女孩暗恋已久。
Tā duì nà wèi piàoliàng de nǚhái ànliàn yǐjiǔ.
He had long had a crush on the pretty young woman.
请看管好您的小孩。
Qǐng kànguǎn hǎo nín de xiǎohái.
Please do not leave your child unattended.

物.o: Phonosemantic compound. 牛 represents the meaning and 勿 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "variety", depicting the variety of colors on a cow. Later the meaning shifted to "things".
w: person; character (in a play, novel etc)
x: 你最想成为哪种动物？
Nǐ zuì xiǎng chéngwéi nǎ zhǒng dòngwù?
What animal would you most like to be?
你对哪种药物过敏吗？
Nǐ duì nǎ zhǒng yàowù guòmǐn ma?
Are you allergic to any medications?
你也太物质了吧。
Nǐ yě tài wùzhì le ba.
You're too materialistic.

c.h: 刂 is a component form of 刀.

利.o: Depicts harvesting grain (禾) with a blade (刂). Harvest was the main source of profit in agricultural societies.
w: to exploit; to make use of; to use
x: 大家把这个资源利用好。
Dàjiā bǎ zhège zīyuán lìyòng hǎo.
Everyone make good use of this resource.
科技应为人民利益服务。
Kējì yīng wèi rénmín lìyì fúwù.
Science and technology should work for the good of the people.
这个胜利来之不易啊。
Zhè ge shènglì láizhībùyì a.
The victory was hard-won.

義.o: Phonosemantic compound. 羊 represents the meaning and 我 represents the sound. In ancient China sheep (羊) were associated with goodness and beauty, which is why 羊 is a component in characters like 美 (beautiful), 善 (benevolent), and 義 (justice).

c.h: 𤣩 is a component form of 玉.

玩.o: Phonosemantic compound. 𤣩 represents the meaning and 元 represents the sound.

Nǐ xǐhuan wánr shénme yóuxì?
What games do you like playing?
什么玩意儿啊这是？
Shénme wányìr a zhè shì?
What on earth is this?

早.o: Phonosemantic compound. 日 represents the meaning and 棗 represents the sound. The form of the original phonetic component 棗 was abbreviated to look like 十.
w: long ago; for a long time
early period; early phase; early stage
x: 你能不能早一点来？

Tā zǎoyǐ bǎ zhè shì pāo dào jiǔxiāoyúnwài qù le.
He had forgotten it completely.

助.o: Phonosemantic compound. 力 represents the meaning and 且 represents the sound.
w: to help; to support; to aid
to help sb in trouble; aid; assistance
to subsidize; to provide financial aid

Wǒmen dàjiā bùyào zìgùzì, yào hùxiāng bāngzhù.

Qǐng zhǎo gōngzuò rényuán xiézhù.

c.h: 彳 is a component form of 行.

復.o: Phonosemantic compound. 彳 represents the meaning and 复 represents the sound.

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.

In your opinion, could the murder be drug - related?
